I am a farmer in Amhara, and this small barley plot near my home is important for our food. I will put some DAP and a little urea because the soil here is tired, but fertilizer is expensive so I cannot use too much. I keep my own barley seed from last harvest like my neighbors do, and I will spread manure from my cattle before plowing. We depend on the belg and meher rains here, so no irrigation, and my wife and sons will help me with the weeding and harvest.
